title: Developer Profile
description: A contributor's last 90 days: a commit trend, commits by repository, pull request outcomes, a contribution heatmap and a language split. Five chart forms in static HTML, CSS and inline SVG, with no chart library and no script.
summary: Sparkline, bars, donut, heatmap and stacked bar, without a chart library.

remix.name: Terminal
remix.description: Green-bar printout by day, phosphor screen by night: JetBrains Mono throughout, tractor-feed margins, square dashed panels, segmented LED bars, a ticked ring and a glow on the figures in the dark. The language colors keep their meaning; open pull requests turn amber through the card's one status hook.

notes: All names, figures and activity are sample data. Render the bar lengths (--ab-value), donut stops (--ab-stop-1, --ab-stop-2), heatmap levels (data-level 0–4) and sparkline path from your own queries.

Every mark reads --ab-series, the theme primary by default. Colors that carry meaning belong to your data: set --ab-series inline per series (the languages) or once per card (the pull request statuses), and render the bar and its legend from the same record.
Each figure stays readable as text: bars and legends print their values, the sparkline, donut and heatmap carry a text summary for assistive technology. The charts have no hover tooltips.
View repositories is a plain link to your own repository list.
